title: how notebook capture fires (v5 trigger-timed)
summary: Capture is trigger-timed, not per-stop: every Stop silently updates per-file evidence records and a score, and when the trigger fires (descent/surge/cap) the checklist payload is written to a tmpdir pending file that the UserPromptSubmit recall hook injects with the user's NEXT prompt — the stop itself is never blocked. Only git-HEAD drift (a commit landing) and SubagentStop deliver blocking.

manual capture does NOT call trigger.step() and does not touch armed/activeStops/stopsSinceFire/quietRun - it only reads the marker and lists/marks worklist files, so it cannot change WHEN automatic capture next fires, only what is still outstanding

Fixed by splitting into two counters: score uses stopsSinceFire (has enough happened), quietRun uses only non-active stops (has it wound down).
MIN_FILES_ARM=1 governs arming and descent (non-blocking); MIN_FILES=2 still governs head-drift and cap, because a one-file BLOCKING prompt is the v4 agitation the design exists to kill
a session that touches ZERO files never fires, however long it runs

evidence is attributed to the FROZEN repo root (marker state.root, derived once via findRepoRoot walk-up), so a mid-session `cd` out of the repo cannot admit a foreign absolute path into the worklist - PR #102 fixed a real case where a session that `cd`'d into ~/.claude/.../memory got those files recorded as if repo-local

captured=true means OFFERED by a fire, not WRITTEN by kb write - the manual path used to filter out every captured file, which silently dropped a session's own just-edited/new files from /capture-notes (PR #113); do not conflate the two states when touching either path

SubagentStop's capture prompt runs as the subagent's OWN turn, and a subagent's return value to its coordinator IS its last message - blocking a SubagentStop for the notebook step overwrote the actual deliverable until a subagent-only 'restate your result last' tail was added (PR #61); any new SubagentStop-blocking behavior needs the same tail or it will re-break this

the flow-note gate is a precision/recall knob that has swung to both extremes on the SAME axis with no automated test: PR #70 tightened it after a 32% junk-flow rate, then PR #100 found it had overcorrected to a hard zero (0 new flows in 6 days, every flow write folding into one pre-existing flow) six weeks later - only caught by eyeballing capture.jsonl rates by hand each time

concurrency identity: the durable worklist and the tmpdir evidence marker MUST share the exact key <sid>-<aid> (aid defaults to 'main'), never sid alone and never root alone - a subagent shares its parent's session id, so a looser key lets a subagent's capture clobber the main agent's list (PR #127 -> re-keyed by PR #133)

every worklist/marker write in this pipeline is deliberately best-effort (try/catch, 'capture must never fail because these could not be written') - correct for not blocking the agent, but means write failures are silent by design. There is no repair/reconciliation command today that checks marker state against worklist-file existence the way `kb repair` checks note shape against the sidecar - a hand-deleted .worklist-<sid>-<aid>.{json,md} stays gone forever for those files.

any change to this pipeline should be checked against the full matrix: 3 hosts (Claude/Cursor/Codex) x 2 roles (main/subagent) x 2 fire modes (automatic score-based / manual on-demand) - a fix scoped to one cell has regressed a different cell almost every time in this file's history (PRs #61, #64, #70, #81, #85, #96, #100, #102, #113, #127, #133)

2026-08-06 MAJOR FIX, previously undiscovered: `/capture-notes` for ALL THREE HOSTS always ran the SAME shared hooks/kb-elicit.mjs --manual (src/init.ts's invocation is host-agnostic), which reads/writes tmpdir()/coldstart-kb-<sid>-<aid>.json. But Cursor's and Codex's OWN automatic Stop hooks (cursor-kb-elicit.mjs, codex-kb-elicit.mjs) wrote to DIFFERENT, host-prefixed marker files (coldstart-cursor-kb-*, coldstart-codex-kb-*) that the shared script's regex/glob never matched. Net effect: manual capture on Cursor/Codex could NEVER see evidence gathered by their own automatic Stop hooks - it always hit 'no notebook-capture evidence yet', even after last session's soleMarkerUnderRoot fallback, because there was nothing under the searched prefix to find. Every existing manual-capture test (this repo's own, before this fix) hand-seeded a coldstart-kb-* marker directly and so never caught it. FIXED by unifying all three hosts onto ONE marker prefix (coldstart-kb-) - src/kb/write-guide.ts's flowEvidenceCount already treated the three prefixes as one logical union by design, which is what made this discoverable: it was already assuming host-agnostic evidence that the marker filenames didn't actually deliver.

2026-08-06 FIX: Cursor/Codex commands have no way to pass a real session id INTO the command body the way Claude's `!`-expansion does (confirmed via official docs, not just transcripts - no ! expansion in .cursor/commands/*.md, no session var on Codex skill bodies). Their own pre-prompt hooks (beforeSubmitPrompt / UserPromptSubmit) DO receive a real session_id though. Fix: the command body carries CAPTURE_SENTINEL (hooks/capture-sentinel.mjs); cursor-kb-recall.mjs/codex-kb-recall.mjs detect it in the submitted prompt and run kb-elicit.mjs --manual --session <real sid> themselves, injecting the result via the SAME additional_context/pending-capture channel already used for automatic-fire delivery. The command body's 'run this in the terminal' wording is kept as an explicit fallback for when the hook is disabled or fails - repair/repairAliases commands are untouched (UserCommand.hookInjected is capture-only, they need no session).

Codex's capture is NOT the same v5 trigger as Claude/Cursor: codex-kb-elicit.mjs does not import trigger.mjs at all and fires decision:block on every Stop that has new evidence, no arm/descent/score. This asymmetry predates 2026-08-06 and was not unified - flagged here, not fixed.

any change to this pipeline should be checked against the full matrix: 3 hosts x 2 roles (main/subagent) x 2 fire modes (automatic/manual) - a fix scoped to one cell has regressed a different cell almost every time in this file's history (PRs #61, #64, #70, #81, #85, #96, #100, #102, #113, #127, #133, plus the two 2026-08-06 fixes above)

(`marker`) — Cursor's OWN Stop/SubagentStop capture logic (does not use trigger.mjs at all - has its own inline evidence/fire logic). As of 2026-08-06 writes its session-state marker to the SAME path kb-elicit.mjs's --manual reads: tmpdir()/coldstart-kb-<sid>-<aid>.json (previously coldstart-cursor-kb-<sid>-<aid>.json, a DIFFERENT file --manual could never see - see Invariants). The per-turn dedupe file (coldstart-cursor-kb-turn-<tid>-<aid>.done) is unrelated and keeps its own cursor-specific prefix.

(`marker`) — Codex's OWN Stop/SubagentStop capture logic - also does not import trigger.mjs; ALWAYS fires decision:block on evidence (no arm/descent threshold at all, unlike Claude/Cursor's v5 trigger - a real asymmetry, not yet unified). As of 2026-08-06 writes to the same unified tmpdir()/coldstart-kb-<sid>-<aid>.json marker (previously coldstart-codex-kb-<sid>-<aid>.json).

(`CAPTURE_SENTINEL`) — the literal string `<!-- coldstart:capture-notes -->` embedded in the Cursor/Codex capture command body (src/init.ts wireCursorCommand/wireCodexSkill, gated on UserCommand.hookInjected) so a host's own pre-prompt recall hook can recognize the submitted prompt IS /capture-notes and act on it.

Cursor's beforeSubmitPrompt: when the submitted prompt contains CAPTURE_SENTINEL and a real session_id is present (which this hook always has, unlike the command surface itself), it runs `kb-elicit.mjs --manual --session <real sid> --root <root>` itself and injects the output via the existing additional_context/pending channel - deterministic, no LLM has to type a correct --session. Falls back to the command's own 'run this in the terminal' wording if the hook is disabled/fails.

Codex's UserPromptSubmit: same CAPTURE_SENTINEL detection and self-run of kb-elicit.mjs --manual, injected via hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext. Every early-exit (no notebook yet, empty query, search failed, no recall hits) falls back to delivering the manual-capture text alone via deliverManualOnlyAndExit, instead of exiting silently and swallowing an explicit /capture-notes.

(`wireCursorCommand`, `wireCodexSkill`, `UserCommand`) — UserCommand gained hookInjected?:boolean (true only for the capture command, not repair/repairAliases which need no session). When set, the Cursor/Codex command body opens with CAPTURE_SENTINEL and reworded fallback text instead of unconditionally telling the agent to run the terminal command.

(`MARKER_PREFIXES`, `flowEvidenceCount`) — the flow-evidence check that unions markers across a session's agents. Simplified 2026-08-06 from 3 per-host prefixes to the one unified prefix now that all hosts write the same marker file.

invariants: mentions (grep hits, bare path tokens) never enter evidence - content tiers only
cap fires INJECT not block - dense sessions starve descent and repeated cap-blocks re-create v4 agitation
pending file = tmpdir coldstart-kb-pending-<sid>.json, 24h TTL, consumed on delivery
manual capture is READ-ONLY on the session marker, so it cannot perturb automatic firing
the manual path prints the payload directly - no pending file, no kb-recall
manual self-discovers the session: freshest tmpdir marker whose recorded files resolve under --root
MIN_FILES_ARM=1 governs arming and descent (non-blocking); MIN_FILES=2 still governs head-drift and cap, because a one-file BLOCKING prompt is the v4 agitation the design exists to kill
a session that touches ZERO files never fires, however long it runs (Claude/Cursor)
manual capture marks the files it LISTED as captured, but leaves armed/activeStops/stopsSinceFire/quietRun untouched - it cannot change WHEN automatic capture fires, only what is still outstanding

evidence is attributed to the FROZEN repo root (marker state.root, derived once via findRepoRoot walk-up to .coldstart/notebook), so a mid-session `cd` out of the repo cannot admit a foreign absolute path into the worklist (PR #102 fixed a real case where a session that cd'd into ~/.claude/.../memory got those files recorded as if repo-local)

capture survives Claude Code /compact via the kb-elicit shrink guard (a transcript shorter than stored lineCount is reprocessed from its new start, not dropped) - PR #81 fixed evidence collection silently dying post-compact for the rest of a session

manual capture requires --session (or exactly one unambiguous marker under --root via soleMarkerUnderRoot); it no longer 'self-discovers the freshest marker' - that guessed wrong when multiple sessions had evidence, which PR #133 closed

EMPIRICAL: descent had NEVER fired in this repo for 6 weeks (104 stops/24 fires, all head-drift or cap) - not a threshold problem. Root cause (PR #96): a 2026-07-21 edit reclassified synthesis turns as quiet (correct, feeds descent) but left the score's engagement term reading activeStops instead of ALL stops since fire, deleting the only score-growth term a pure-discussion session has. Fixed by splitting into two counters: score uses stopsSinceFire (has enough happened), quietRun uses only non-active stops (has it wound down)

captured=true means OFFERED by a fire, not WRITTEN by kb write - the manual path used to filter out every captured file, which silently dropped a session's own just-edited/new files from /capture-notes (PR #113); do not conflate the two states when touching either path

SubagentStop's capture prompt runs as the subagent's OWN turn, and a subagent's return value to its coordinator IS its last message - blocking a SubagentStop for the notebook step overwrote the actual deliverable until a subagent-only 'restate your result last' tail was added (PR #61); any new SubagentStop-blocking behavior needs the same tail or it will re-break this

the flow-note gate is a precision/recall knob that has swung to both extremes on the SAME axis with no automated test: PR #70 tightened it after a 32% junk-flow rate, then PR #100 found it had overcorrected to a hard zero (0 new flows in 6 days, every flow write folding into one pre-existing flow) six weeks later - only caught by eyeballing capture.jsonl rates by hand each time

concurrency identity: the durable worklist and the tmpdir evidence marker MUST share the exact key <sid>-<aid> (aid defaults to 'main'), never sid alone and never root alone - a subagent shares its parent's session id, so a looser key lets a subagent's capture clobber the main agent's list (PR #127 -> re-keyed by PR #133)

every worklist/marker write in this pipeline is deliberately best-effort (try/catch, 'capture must never fail because these could not be written') - correct for not blocking the agent, but means write failures are silent by design. There is no repair/reconciliation command today that checks marker state against worklist-file existence the way `kb repair` checks note shape against the sidecar - a hand-deleted .worklist-<sid>-<aid>.{json,md} stays gone forever for those files, UNLESS it is a captured read-only file, which is recovered by manual capture (see the 2026-08-06 fix below)

any change to this pipeline should be checked against the full matrix: 3 hosts (Claude/Cursor/Codex) x 2 roles (main/subagent) x 2 fire modes (automatic score-based / manual on-demand) - a fix scoped to one cell has regressed a different cell almost every time in this file's history (PRs #61, #64, #70, #81, #85, #96, #100, #102, #113, #127, #133, plus the 2026-08-06 fixes below)

2026-08-06 FIX: a captured READ-ONLY file whose durable worklist artifact (.worklist-<sid>-<aid>.json) is missing - hand-deleted, or the write itself failed - is now re-included by manual capture even though captured=true, because there is no other live copy of that checklist anywhere. Checked via a fresh existsSync(worklistJsonPath(...)) at manual-capture time (hooks/kb-elicit.mjs), NOT via any change to trigger.mjs or automatic firing - deliberately narrow scope to avoid yet another regression cycle. Automatic firing does NOT self-heal a lost worklist; running /capture-notes (now working correctly on all 3 hosts, see below) is the recovery path

2026-08-06 MAJOR FIX, previously undiscovered: `/capture-notes` for ALL THREE HOSTS always ran the SAME shared hooks/kb-elicit.mjs --manual (src/init.ts's invocation is host-agnostic), which reads/writes tmpdir()/coldstart-kb-<sid>-<aid>.json. But Cursor's and Codex's OWN automatic Stop hooks (cursor-kb-elicit.mjs, codex-kb-elicit.mjs) wrote to DIFFERENT, host-prefixed marker files (coldstart-cursor-kb-*, coldstart-codex-kb-*) that the shared script's regex/glob never matched. Net effect: manual capture on Cursor/Codex could NEVER see evidence gathered by their own automatic Stop hooks - it always hit 'no notebook-capture evidence yet', even after the prior session's soleMarkerUnderRoot fallback, because there was nothing under the searched prefix to find. Every existing manual-capture test (this repo's own, before this fix) hand-seeded a coldstart-kb-* marker directly and so never caught it. FIXED by unifying all three hosts onto ONE marker prefix (coldstart-kb-) - src/kb/write-guide.ts's flowEvidenceCount already treated the three prefixes as one logical union by design, which is what made this discoverable: it was already assuming host-agnostic evidence that the marker filenames didn't actually deliver

2026-08-06 FIX: Cursor/Codex commands have no way to pass a real session id INTO the command body the way Claude's `!`-expansion does (confirmed via official docs, not just transcripts - no ! expansion in .cursor/commands/*.md, no session var on Codex skill bodies). Their own pre-prompt hooks (beforeSubmitPrompt / UserPromptSubmit) DO receive a real session_id though. Fix: the command body carries CAPTURE_SENTINEL (hooks/capture-sentinel.mjs); cursor-kb-recall.mjs/codex-kb-recall.mjs detect it in the submitted prompt and run kb-elicit.mjs --manual --session <real sid> themselves, injecting the result via the SAME additional_context/pending-capture channel already used for automatic-fire delivery. The command body's 'run this in the terminal' wording is kept as an explicit fallback for when the hook is disabled or fails - repair/repairAliases commands are untouched (UserCommand.hookInjected is capture-only, they need no session)

Codex's capture is NOT the same v5 trigger as Claude/Cursor: codex-kb-elicit.mjs does not import trigger.mjs at all and fires decision:block on every Stop that has new evidence, no arm/descent/score. This asymmetry predates 2026-08-06 and was not unified - flagged here, not fixed

2026-08-06 FIX: the static instructions half of the capture payload (DECIDE-FIRST/per-note/FLOWS/WRITE rules) is now generated ONCE per repo into the permanent, gitignored `.coldstart/notebook/.capture-instructions.md` (hooks/capture-payload.mjs ensureCaptureInstructions/shippedInstructionsTemplate), version-tagged so a future edit to the template self-heals a stale on-disk copy instead of silently drifting. This is a pure disk-I/O simplification (USER's own proposal, deferred to after the prior PR merged) - it does NOT change what the agent reads on any given fire (buildCapturePayload's return value still inlines the full instructions every time) and does NOT touch the worklist-deletion recovery fix above (that protects the per-session JSON half - files/tier/needsNote - which must stay per-session and deletable; only the static prose half moved to a permanent file). The per-session .worklist-<sid>-<aid>.md shrank from a full ~10KB duplicate to a ~400-byte worklist+pointer
